tool.name: Create representative library from DANTE_LTR output
tool.command: cp '$dante_ltr' dante_ltr.gff3 && dante_ltr_to_library --gff3 dante_ltr.gff3 --reference_sequence '$reference' --output_dir output --cpu \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} --min_coverage 3 && ls -l output && mv output/mmseqs2/mmseqs_representative_seq_clean.fasta $dante_ltr_library

param.name: dante_ltr
param.label: GFF3 output from DANTE_LTR retrotransposon identification pipeline

data.name: dante_ltr_library
data.label: Representative library from DANTE_LTR $dante_ltr.hid on reference $reference.hid

tool.help: This tool extract representative sequences from LTR-RT library identified by DANTE_LTR. Resulting library is suitable for RepeatMasker search.
